generator_cmd: printf %s "$plain" | xxd -p -c0 | tr a-f A-F | sed 's/^/ibase=16; /' | BC_LINE_LENGTH=0 bc  # Mastery fragment as its own decimal integer (17 digits)
oracle_cmd: printf %s "$encoded" | .venv/bin/python -I -c "import sys;from Crypto.Util.number import long_to_bytes;print(long_to_bytes(int(sys.stdin.read().strip(),10)).decode())"  # pycryptodome long_to_bytes (RSA style, big-endian)
